objective.primaryRule: NL0 1.0.0 §3.5 original rule: the actual-profit role among the Q1-Q6 qualified members (highest centre net; ties: higher selection robust net, lower centre DD, label), per independent arm population (D, G, C, J, S) at every cutoff and per informed population (D+, G+, C+) at C24; RA1 report-only. The determination (PROTOCOL.md §12) is a separate precommitted governance label.

risk.denominator: one fixed $100,000 initial trading allocation (not peak account equity); P0 = 35 % of it; trade principal loss, banked-capital DD and giveback are report-only

budget.notes: Distinct candidate proposals: the configured base broad lanes x (512 screen + 2 x 256 island) per cutoff — D 48, G 72, J 288, S 18 x 14 lanes (F = 3) — over 4 cutoffs, before refinement and informed designs, extension islands and replicate rounds (PROTOCOL.md §7.7). Backend evaluations: the hard ceiling of 160,000,000 requested official evaluations (archive hits included; fresh and hits reported separately; ledger over the sealed stage records); deterministic per-lane bounds of budget.ts laneCaps, 650/652 per qualified member, 306 per slice subject.

evaluationBackend.notes: Every official evaluation (searches, replicate rounds, informed lanes, qualification, fold slices, validation) runs only through openOfficialGpuSession -> GpuPool -> EvalLab on the accepted GPU Phase 7 evaluator (record sha256 bb0e3fcf..., binary gb7 cb2ff30b..., RTX 5090 GPU-ae5f222c...), node --no-maglev, one held job per stage; no CPU fallback. Engineering gates, data tools, the pilot, report-only diagnostics and the total-portfolio stage are non-official (parity-test / benchmark / diagnostic).

chronologicalConsequence: Standard 3.0.0 §1.8 default, adopted: a failed or uncomputable independent verdict of an arm's procedure — and every informed selection (no independent chronological test) — means 'no chronological support: the selection is not a deployment-qualified candidate without an explicit user decision'. Governance only. 'No qualifying GDX candidate' is a valid outcome.

deviations.description: The GDX space: P6-TSLA's space unchanged (Assignment 3's genome semantics on one trading slot: the accepted engine's VGT-named slot carries GDX; the second slot's books disabled; no evaluation file changed); arms D (8 D1 cells), G (6 Growth exit-protection cells), J (48), S (frozen D1 x 6), C (fixed pairs). S1 absent; shadow eligibility OFF; calendar-day holds.

Effort by replicates of NL0's unchanged per-lane schedules: P6-TSLA's executed allocation x 1.5 in every stage (base D 6, G 12, J 6, S R_S(F) = max(6, ceil(240 / (6F))) = 14 for F = 3; 6 refinement lanes per refined cell), Priority 5's two-tier island rule and convergence-driven replicate rounds (<= 4, 2 %).
deviations.justification: Brief Phase 2/4 (generous GPU effort, convergence-driven extensions); standard §4.8 proportional scaling.

deviations.description: Priority 5's exact sequential drawdown statistic from GPU marks; one procedure per arm.
deviations.justification: The accepted GPU path returns no minute mark series; a CPU-scored official statistic is forbidden (§9.2).

deviations.description: NL0's original rule is THE selector; RA1 computed on the identical populations as a separately labelled report-only experimental selector (never selects).
deviations.justification: Brief Phase 2 (the established algorithms faithfully; the fitness never adapted).

deviations.description: Method comparison: C (separately optimized, pooled), J (joint), S (D1-first sequential), with D and G standalone; matched rules; effort matched by the frozen R_S rule (S + its D1 step >= J) and disclosed per arm.
Assignment 3's instrument on the trading slot in this study's seed namespace, common random numbers across centres and arms; arm S's design neighbourhoods never move the frozen D1.
Priority 5's eight stresses (cost 0/2/10/20 bps, 14 % interest, stop slippage +10/+25 bps, next-open stops).

Precommitted determination: finalists with immutable (population, id) identities and labels sealed before FULL; the outcome joins validation records by (population, id) via src/research-outcome/identityJoin.ts and fails closed; architecture comparisons with Priority 5's bands and replication; 'no qualifying GDX candidate' valid.
D1 hold-window tail stress on pre-2016 GDX daily data (2006-05-22 -> 2015-12-31, Yahoo; disjoint) plus in-sample.
The common complete endpoint is 2026-10-30 (the program's horizon; GDX, VOOG, VGT complete on it).

GDX incumbents (N/original's, New L0's, VG #2's GDX D1 books; 4A's GDX Growth export set) are exact controls at every cutoff; a separately labelled incumbent-informed lane at C24 for arms D and G; informed populations D+, G+, C+ (incumbents are members, standard §3.2) with no independent chronological test.
Combined arms require both GDX books funded (Q6); protected and unrestricted Growth structures protected by cells and reported as sub-populations.

GDX has no split in the window: the central split ledger applies (no GDX event; one there fails the doors closed); the price-only convention of every strategy is unchanged and its effect reported in the portfolio stage.
The matched total-portfolio comparison (PROTOCOL §15) is a precommitted report-only stage after the outcome, on frozen subjects; it never selects.
